name: Triumph Speed Twin 5T
engine: 498 cc air-cooled OHV pre-unit parallel twin, one carb, magneto
intro: Edward Turner's twin that set the pattern for British bikes. Pre-unit, magneto ignition and girder or telescopic forks.

K: The gearbox is separate from the engine and has its own oil. Check and change both, and set the primary chain.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
